scope: Read-only source review of native input tooling. This is not an input acceptance result.

findings.fact: The tool computes click coordinates from GetTickSpaceGeometry().GetAbsolutePositionAtCoordinates(0.5,0.5).
findings.implication: An unresolved, zero, or stale widget geometry can produce a click at the wrong location.

findings.fact: The tool dispatches native mouse move/down/up and returns true without checking that the intended button handled the events.
findings.implication: Click=true proves dispatch, not OnClicked or the expected game result.

findings.fact: Type calls SetKeyboardFocus directly before entering text.
findings.implication: Even Type with empty text changes focus. It must be recorded as a focus intervention, not as natural focus restoration.

findings.fact: The Focused desired target log is emitted before UWidget::SetFocus.
findings.implication: Confirm actual focus from Slate or UWidget observations; the log alone is not sufficient.
EditableTextBox can contain a focused SEditableText while its own HasAnyUserFocus is false. Observe both and retain the actual Slate focused node.
findings.fact: HasAnyUserFocus tests the cached widget itself; HasFocusedDescendants is a separate query.

runtimeStatus: Parent observed natural second logout followed by native Tab focusing the inner Password SEditableText and then SignIn, without OutputLog intervention. Initial failure was not reproduced through this natural input path; no runtime code changed.
